# Vendored

| File | From | Version | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pdf.min.mjs`, `pdf.worker.min.mjs` | [PDF.js](https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js) (`pdfjs-dist`, `build/`) | 4.10.38 | Apache-2.0, notice at the head of each file |

Served as-is to draw PDFs in the left pane. To update, copy the same two files
from a newer `pdfjs-dist` and change the version here.
